answer: Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 4 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the ivory bond on all of them and exposing each to the vertex slash. Because the river audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A 259 account operation therefore ties up 22 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
